title: 第4章 真以为我李家没人了！？
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
刘美玉美艳的脸蛋儿上全是渴望，不停朝李大壮挺胸，红唇微微张开，说着勾人的騒话。

    李大壮好不容易压下去的邪火，又一下窜了上来，以前咋就没发现，刘美玉这么騒？

    “傻大壮，你还等啥呢？快来呀~~”刘美玉等不及了，踮起脚环抱住李大壮的脖子。

    幽幽的女人香直往李大壮的鼻子里钻，被刘美玉故意拉低的衣领里，两座雪山摇摇晃晃，雪白的颜色勾的李大壮眼晕，体内火苗更是直冲头顶！

    这哪里还能忍？

    李大壮直接把手里的老鳖往旁边的洗衣盆里一扔，扭头抱着李美玉朝屋里走去。

    “大壮~~”

    刘美玉仿佛预感到，自己即将得到一场暴雨的洗礼，这下渴了许久的大地，一定能喝个饱了！

    想到这儿，她激动的娇躯都在颤抖！

    可就在这个时候，李大壮的耳朵忽然动了动，他好像听见自己家的方向传来一个熟悉的女人声音，好像在大喊着什么！

    “咋了大壮？你个傻小子还挺坏，老吊着人家，非得让人家自己动手……”刘美玉见李大壮停下来了，她难受的嗔怪。

    “不对劲，好像是秋霜姐在喊！”得到修为后的李大壮耳力也提升了不少，虽然听不真切，但确实是养姐李秋霜的声音！

    “嫂子，我家可能出事了，我得先回去看看，老鳖先放你这儿！”

    李大壮哪里还有心情干啥，起身就往外跑，老鳖太大，拎回去被外人看到，容易招人惦记！

    “大壮你家那么远，你能听见啥！？”

    刘美玉急的直跺脚：“这傻小子，咋老关键时候掉链子呀！”

    “哎不对！大壮刚才那眼神，急的好像要吃人，可没有半点傻气，难不成，这混小子真不傻了，刚才都是在骗我！？”

    …………

    李大壮不知道刘美玉的心思，他满心里都是对李秋霜的担忧！

    李秋霜是十年前，被李大壮爸妈在杏花山上的一处悬崖边捡到的，当时这姑娘就睡在崖边上，翻个身都能掉下悬崖！

    老两口赶紧把她叫醒，一问才发现，这姑娘竟然失忆了！

    她不知道自己叫啥，不知道自己家在哪，要不是一双眼睛灵动俏丽，穿的衣服也干净利落，老两口都要以为她是个傻的了！

    老两口心善，把她送去了执法所，可执法所也找不到她家人，为了不让姑娘流落孤儿院，老两口就把她领回了家，看她身形比李大壮高一些，就让李大壮叫她姐！

    姐弟俩朝夕相处了十年，感情好的和一个人似的，李大壮绝不想让李秋霜出事！

    可此时，李家的破院子里，李秋霜正被一脸淫笑的村长儿子王耀根，逼到了墙角！

    李秋霜长得漂亮水灵，皮肤又白又嫩，一点不像农村姑娘，长长的麻花辫垂在胸前，丰满有料的前胸，把麻花辫托的高高的，细腰纤细如柳，长腿又细又直，此时正因为害怕，微微颤抖，却更添几分楚楚动人的风情！
content_en:
Liu Meiyu didn't want Li Dazhuang to commit a murder for her, and would rather use her body to stop this silly boy. Besides, she originally wanted to give it to him...

    "But they bullied my sister-in-law!" Although Li Dazhuang was unbearably hot, he was still angry, with a fierce look in his eyes!

    "Silly Da Zhuang, you arrived in time, they haven't succeeded yet! But Da Zhuang? Why are you different from before?" Liu Meiyu suddenly froze: "Is it possible that you are not stupid!?"

    Liu Meiyu was excited and worried. If Da Zhuang wasn't stupid, then the words she said when she seduced him before... were too embarrassing!

    He doesn't think of himself as a wanton and thirsty woman, right?

    "Da Zhuang, sister-in-law... sister-in-law is not that kind of woman, sister-in-law only treats you..."

    "Hehe! Sister-in-law, I don't understand what you are talking about about men and women, hehe!"

    Li Dazhuang saw through Liu Meiyu's thoughts. In order to successfully eat Dabai steamed buns, he had better continue to act stupid!

    He covered up the glint in his eyes, returned to his silly look, and stretched out his hands to massage Liu Meiyu's fair and tender body as before.

    "Sister-in-law, the bad guys have been knocked unconscious. I even helped you press your body to make you comfortable...Sister-in-law, you also said you wanted to give me a big white steamed bun, but you can't keep your word, hehehehe!"

    Seeing Li Dazhuang's silly smile, Liu Meiyu felt relieved, and felt Li Dazhuang's rough but hot hands. Liu Meiyu's whole body seemed to melt, and she collapsed softly in Li Dazhuang's arms!

    "Da Zhuang... quickly, take my sister-in-law to the river to wash her. The dirty hands of those two bastards just touched my sister-in-law. Wash them clean before you eat..."

    "Hey, wash up and eat steamed buns!" Li Dazhuang picked up Liu Meiyu with a silly smile and walked towards the river.

    Li Dazhuang, who had gone through the baptism of cultivation, became taller and stronger. Liu Meiyu nestled against his strong chest, feeling his strong abdominal muscles, and the inexplicable emptiness and longing in her heart became stronger!

    Li Dazhuang quickly carried Liu Meiyu into the river. The cool river water made Liu Meiyu shiver. When her delicate body moved in Li Dazhuang's arms, Li Dazhuang's already hot heart suddenly became even more unbearable!

    But now he still has to pretend to be a fool who doesn't understand anything. He can only smile stupidly: "Sister-in-law, I am strong, I will help you wash it!"

    Li Dazhuang reached out and rubbed Liu Meiyu's back. Liu Meiyu suddenly screamed: "Oh~Dazhuang~"

    "Sister-in-law, what's wrong with you? Did you exert too much force? Does it hurt you?"

    "No~ no! You're stupid and strong, it's better if you have more energy, sister-in-law, sister-in-law only likes people who are very energetic~" Liu Meiyu was panting, her snow-white figure couldn't help but tremble slightly.

    Li Dazhuang was much taller than her, and he could see her clearly from the front and back. In front of her were the two strange and familiar snow-capped mountains, which were trembling with Liu Meiyu.

    The buttocks at the back are like two semi-circular mountain buns, plump and vigorous, swaying gently, in sharp contrast with the thin waist of the willow above. She is thin where she should be thin, and fat where she should be fat. Li Dazhuang's whole body feels hot when he looks at it, and he can't move his eyes away!
title_en: Chapter 3 Silly Da Zhuang, please help your sister-in-law, okay?
